system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: 系统默认 Prompt 模板
system_prompt_style.note: Prompt fields (duty/constraint/few_shots) stored per agent and assembled; prompt templates in backend/prompts/manager_system_prompt_template_en.yaml. Inferred from docs only.

observation_format.evidence_quote: 🎭 Multimodal Interaction** | Voice, text, images, files — comprehensive natural dialogue
observation_format.note: Tool results appear as text/SSE; images mentioned as user interaction modality.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: 🔧 MCP Tool Ecosystem** | Plug-and-play extension system with custom development and third-party MCP service support
tool_call_format.note: MCP tools implied to be called via function calling; parser not shown in evidence.

tool_count.evidence_quote: 首版固定为五个模型可见 Tool
tool_count.note: Count is for the NL2Agent runtime agent, not a general default agent; user agents bind arbitrary MCP tools.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote:
The Local MCP tool only searches the catalog. Agent draft editing is performed
by the frontend configuration store.
edit_primitive.note: No file-editing primitive visible in evidence.

tool_schema_source.note: Pydantic models for tool inputs (auto_generated); MCP servers supply schemas.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: A2A Agent Collaboration** | Agent-to-Agent protocol enables seamless multi-agent cooperation and distributed workflows

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: 当前 NL2Agent `max_steps=5`，新流程同一轮需要多次保存 Prompt，调整为 `max_steps=8`。
loop_primitives.note: Step-limited tool-calling loop; NL2Agent generation follows a fixed staged flow.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: 模型判断信息是否足够；不足时输出需求澄清卡
planning_granularity.note: No stored plan object visible in evidence.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: A2A Agent Collaboration** | Agent-to-Agent protocol enables seamless multi-agent cooperation and distributed workflows
multi_agent_topology.note: Managed/manager prompt templates (managed_system_prompt_template_en.yaml, manager_system_prompt_template_en.yaml) imply manager-managed agents; default topology not explicit.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Agent-to-Agent protocol enables seamless multi-agent cooperation and distributed workflows
delegation_mechanism.note: A2A client/server apps (backend/apps/a2a_client_app.py); mechanism details not in evidence.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: 用户多选资源、分别配置，并点击“批量绑定”。
human_in_loop.note: Human confirms clarification, installation and binding cards in the NL2Agent flow; per-tool-call approval not shown.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Agent 数据库草稿是 Agent 配置的唯一事实来源。

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: 🧠 Layered Memory Mechanism** | Two-tier memory (user-level + user-agent-level) for persistent context across conversations
long_term_memory.note: Also 📝 Progressive Skill Disclosure and memory_long_term_db.py; knowledge base uses vector retrieval.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: 🔢 Agent Version Management** | Version iteration and history rollback, safe and controllable
state_persistence.note: Agent config versioning; conversation-level resume for NL2Agent explicitly not supported ('不持久化 NL2Agent 会话').

self_verification.note: Evaluation subsystem (agent_evaluation_service.py, evaluator_app.py) provides LLM judging; not on by default in a normal run.

retry_policy.note: Only per-item binding retry in UI; no task-level retry policy in evidence.

rollback.evidence_quote: Version iteration and history rollback, safe and controllable
rollback.note: Version rollback is of agent configuration in DB, not of filesystem; closest value chosen, mismatch noted.

cost_controls.note: quota_service.py/quota_app.py suggest usage quotas; details not in evidence.

execution_isolation.note: Platform deployed via Docker/Kubernetes; MCP container service (mcp_container_service.py) runs tools in containers.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: 👥 Multi-Tenancy & RBAC** | Multi-tenant isolation, role-based access control, fine-grained resource management
filesystem_access.note: Relative to the container boundary; tenant-scoped resources.

network_policy.evidence_quote: 🌐 Internet Knowledge Integration** | Multi-source search blending real-time information with private data
network_policy.note: No egress restriction found in the available evidence.

permission_model.evidence_quote: 只返回 `is_available=true` 且用户可见的资源
permission_model.note: Tools must be installed and bound to the agent; RBAC gates resources. Per-call approval not default.

tracing.evidence_quote: Monitoring-specific settings are generated from `deploy/env/monitoring.env.example` into `deploy/env/monitoring.env`.
tracing.note: backend/apps/monitoring_app.py and monitoring env suggest telemetry export; exact stack not in evidence.

replayability.evidence_quote: 不持久化 NL2Agent 会话、卡片状态或流程进度。
replayability.note: No replay mechanism found in evidence; conversations are stored (conversation_db.py) but replay not shown.

eval_hooks.note: Evaluation sets, evaluators, annotation and runtime evaluation apps ship in the repo; no standard benchmark named.

guardrails.note: Guardrail regex prompts plus RBAC/permission checks on tool binding.

target_domain.evidence_quote: zero-code platform for auto-generating production-grade AI agents using Harness Engineering principles — unified tools, skills, memory, and orchestration
target_domain.note: Knowledge base / RAG plus arbitrary MCP tools.

open_source.evidence_quote: Nexent is licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE).
